para_trans: amuse fed, t. On constitution of a committee under the chairmanship of Collector, Pune for construction of a memorial for the first revolutionary King Umaji Naik at Purandar, District Pune.
Read: - Department of Rural Development Government Decision No: Memorial-2016 / Q. No.03 / Para-9, D. 11.08.2016

Fun lights, Ta. It is hereby approved to constitute a District Level Committee under the Chairmanship of the District Collector, Pune to take into consideration the provisions of the Government Decision in respect of construction of a memorial for the first revolutionary King Umaji Naik at Purandar District, Pune and to make recommendations and control the construction as follows.
table_trans: Superintendent Engineer, Public Works Board, Pune
Executive Engineer, Zilla Parishad Construction Department, Pune
Assistant Director, Department of Archaeology and Museums or Assistant Custodian, District Level Officer working under the Museum, Pune
Director, District Level Officer working under Archives Directorate, Pune
District Level Officer working under Directorate of Arts, Pune
Assistant Director, Town Planning or Town Planner, Pune (Urban Development Department)

para_trans: Government Decision No: Memorial-2026 / ₹-1 650098 / Yo-11, Dt. August 18, 2026
2. The aforesaid Committee has approved the Government Decision No. Memorial-2016 / P.No.03 / Para-9, D.
In view of the terms and conditions in the 11.08.2016, the necessary aspects should be examined and the appropriate proposal should be submitted to the government.
3. This Government Decision is available on the Government of Maharashtra website www.maharashtra.gov.in.
